name: Generic constraint
meaning: A requirement that a generic type must satisfy so its promised operations can be used.
context: Swift language behavior; platform and local workflow limits remain explicit.

name: Associated type equality
meaning: A generic relationship requiring two protocol type slots to name the same concrete type.

name: Opaque result identity

name: Optional filtering

name: Accumulator

name: Result payload

name: Structured child lifetime
